entity<|#|>Query Parser Derivation Computing Device<|#|>Artifact<|#|>A computing device that derives a query parser for parsing unstructured geographic web-search queries into a field-based format.
entity<|#|>Query Parser<|#|>Artifact<|#|>A parser derived by the query parser derivation computing device that parses unstructured geographic web-search queries into a field-based format using conditional random fields.
entity<|#|>Unstructured Geographic Web-Search Query<|#|>Data<|#|>An unstructured search query of a geographic nature that is parsed into a field-based format.
entity<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>Method<|#|>A statistical modeling method learned by semi-supervised automated learning and used to parse structured information from unstructured geographic web-search queries.
entity<|#|>Semi-Supervised Automated Learning<|#|>Method<|#|>An automated learning approach by which the conditional random fields are learned.
entity<|#|>Rule-Based Finite State Machine Model<|#|>Method<|#|>One of the models that may be used to establish the semi-supervised conditional random fields.
entity<|#|>Statistics-Based Conditional Random Field Model<|#|>Method<|#|>One of the models that may be used to establish the semi-supervised conditional random fields.
entity<|#|>Systematic Geographic Parsing<|#|>Method<|#|>A parsing technique used with the rule-based finite state machine model or the statistics-based conditional random field model to establish the semi-supervised conditional random fields.
entity<|#|>Learned Model Parser<|#|>Artifact<|#|>A parser applied to an unstructured local geographical web-based query in a local domain, comprising at least one class-level n-gram language model-based feature.
entity<|#|>Class-Based Query Log<|#|>Data<|#|>A query log from a form-based query system used in applying the learned model parser to a query.
entity<|#|>Form-Based Query System<|#|>Artifact<|#|>A query system that provides the class-based query log.
entity<|#|>Class-Level N-Gram Language Model-Based Feature<|#|>Data<|#|>A feature harvested from a structured query log and comprised by the learned model parser.
entity<|#|>Structured Query Log<|#|>Data<|#|>A log from which the class-level n-gram language model-based feature is harvested.
entity<|#|>Input Query<|#|>Data<|#|>A query received as input that comprises a series of tokens.
entity<|#|>Tokens<|#|>Data<|#|>The series of tokens comprising the input query, to which labels are assigned.
entity<|#|>Labels<|#|>Data<|#|>Labels assigned to tokens of the input query, identifying them as corresponding to a search term, a geographic expression, a geographic expression relation indication, and/or uninteresting information.
entity<|#|>Most Probable Label Sequence<|#|>Data<|#|>The calculated most probable sequence of labels for the input query.
entity<|#|>Sentences<|#|>Data<|#|>Sentences assigned to each label based at least in part on the most probable label sequence, different from the labels.
entity<|#|>Feature Functions<|#|>Concept<|#|>A set of one or more feature functions representing a state transition feature and/or features of an output state for an input sequence, used to compute a conditional probability.
entity<|#|>State Transition Feature<|#|>Concept<|#|>A feature representing a state transition, trained on a labeled set with learning limited relative to learning the output state features.
entity<|#|>Output State Features<|#|>Concept<|#|>One or more features of an output state for an input sequence, trained on a labeled set.
entity<|#|>Labeled Set<|#|>Data<|#|>A set of labeled data on which the state transition features and output state features are trained.
entity<|#|>Structured Information<|#|>Data<|#|>Information produced from the unstructured geographic web-search query by utilizing the conditional random fields.
entity<|#|>Multiple Interpretation Condition<|#|>Concept<|#|>A condition in which parsing the unstructured geographic web-search query results in multiple interpretations.
entity<|#|>First Interpretation<|#|>Concept<|#|>A first interpretation of the unstructured geographic web-search query corresponding to first parsing results.
entity<|#|>Second Interpretation<|#|>Concept<|#|>A second interpretation of the unstructured geographic web-search query corresponding to second parsing results.
entity<|#|>First Parsing Results<|#|>Data<|#|>Parsing results corresponding to the first interpretation of the unstructured geographic web-search query.
entity<|#|>Second Parsing Results<|#|>Data<|#|>Parsing results corresponding to the second interpretation of the unstructured geographic web-search query.
entity<|#|>User Behavior Data<|#|>Data<|#|>Data used to disambiguate the first parsing results and the second parsing results.
entity<|#|>Class-Based Language Model Features<|#|>Data<|#|>Features comprising at least one token appearing in a defined position in a model feature comprising a grouping of tokens of a given length n.
entity<|#|>GEO_UNI_FIRST<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length one relating to a geographic term.
entity<|#|>GEO_BI_FIRST<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a geographic term.
entity<|#|>GEO_BI_SECOND<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a geographic term.
entity<|#|>GEO_TRI_FIRST<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a geographic term.
entity<|#|>GEO_TRI_SECOND<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a geographic term.
entity<|#|>GEO_TRI_THIRD<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the third token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a geographic term.
entity<|#|>ST_UNI_FIRST<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length one relating to a search term.
entity<|#|>ST_BI_FIRST<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a search term.
entity<|#|>ST_BI_SECOND<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length two relating to a search term.
entity<|#|>ST_TRI_FIRST<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the first token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a search term.
entity<|#|>ST_TRI_SECOND<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the second token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a search term.
entity<|#|>ST_TRI_THIRD<|#|>Data<|#|>A class-based language model feature for the third token in a grouping of tokens of length three relating to a search term.
relation<|#|>Query Parser Derivation Computing Device<|#|>Query Parser<|#|>derives, creates<|#|>The query parser derivation computing device derives the query parser for parsing unstructured geographic web-search queries into a field-based format.
relation<|#|>Query Parser<|#|>Unstructured Geographic Web-Search Query<|#|>parses<|#|>The query parser parses the unstructured geographic web-search query into a field-based format.
relation<|#|>Query Parser<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>utilizes<|#|>The query parser utilizes conditional random fields learned by semi-supervised automated learning to produce structured information from the unstructured geographic web-search query.
relation<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>Semi-Supervised Automated Learning<|#|>learned by<|#|>The conditional random fields are learned by semi-supervised automated learning.
relation<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>Rule-Based Finite State Machine Model<|#|>established via<|#|>The semi-supervised conditional random fields may be established via the rule-based finite state machine model.
relation<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>Statistics-Based Conditional Random Field Model<|#|>established via<|#|>The semi-supervised conditional random fields may be established via the statistics-based conditional random field model.
relation<|#|>Systematic Geographic Parsing<|#|>Rule-Based Finite State Machine Model<|#|>used with<|#|>Systematic geographic parsing is used with the rule-based finite state machine model.
relation<|#|>Systematic Geographic Parsing<|#|>Statistics-Based Conditional Random Field Model<|#|>used with<|#|>Systematic geographic parsing is used with the statistics-based conditional random field model.
relation<|#|>Learned Model Parser<|#|>Class-Based Query Log<|#|>uses<|#|>The learned model parser is applied to a query using at least one class-based query log.
relation<|#|>Class-Based Query Log<|#|>Form-Based Query System<|#|>from<|#|>The class-based query log comes from a form-based query system.
relation<|#|>Learned Model Parser<|#|>Class-Level N-Gram Language Model-Based Feature<|#|>comprises<|#|>The learned model parser comprises at least one class-level n-gram language model-based feature.
relation<|#|>Class-Level N-Gram Language Model-Based Feature<|#|>Structured Query Log<|#|>harvested from<|#|>The class-level n-gram language model-based feature is harvested from a structured query log.
relation<|#|>Query Parser Derivation Computing Device<|#|>Input Query<|#|>receives<|#|>The query parser derivation computing device receives an input query comprising a series of tokens.
relation<|#|>Input Query<|#|>Tokens<|#|>comprises<|#|>The input query comprises a series of tokens.
relation<|#|>Tokens<|#|>Labels<|#|>assigned<|#|>A label is assigned to each of a plurality of the tokens.
relation<|#|>Input Query<|#|>Most Probable Label Sequence<|#|>calculated for<|#|>The most probable label sequence is calculated for the input query.
relation<|#|>Labels<|#|>Sentences<|#|>assigned<|#|>One or more sentences are assigned to each label based at least in part on the most probable label sequence.
relation<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>Feature Functions<|#|>created based on<|#|>A conditional random field model is created based at least in part on the tokens, the labels, and a set of feature functions.
relation<|#|>Feature Functions<|#|>State Transition Feature<|#|>represent<|#|>The set of feature functions represents a state transition feature.
relation<|#|>Feature Functions<|#|>Output State Features<|#|>represent<|#|>The set of feature functions represents one or more features of an output state for an input sequence.
relation<|#|>State Transition Feature<|#|>Labeled Set<|#|>trained on<|#|>The state transition features are trained on a labeled set.
relation<|#|>Output State Features<|#|>Labeled Set<|#|>trained on<|#|>The output state features are trained on a labeled set.
relation<|#|>Conditional Random Fields<|#|>Structured Information<|#|>produces<|#|>The conditional random fields are utilized to produce structured information from the unstructured geographic web-search query.
relation<|#|>Unstructured Geographic Web-Search Query<|#|>Multiple Interpretation Condition<|#|>results in<|#|>Parsing the unstructured geographic web-search query may result in a multiple interpretation condition.
relation<|#|>Multiple Interpretation Condition<|#|>First Interpretation<|#|>identifies<|#|>The parsing identifies a first interpretation of the unstructured geographic web-search query.
relation<|#|>Multiple Interpretation Condition<|#|>Second Interpretation<|#|>identifies<|#|>The parsing identifies a second interpretation of the unstructured geographic web-search query.
relation<|#|>First Interpretation<|#|>First Parsing Results<|#|>corresponds to<|#|>The first interpretation corresponds to first parsing results.
relation<|#|>Second Interpretation<|#|>Second Parsing Results<|#|>corresponds to<|#|>The second interpretation corresponds to second parsing results.
relation<|#|>User Behavior Data<|#|>First Parsing Results<|#|>disambiguates<|#|>Based at least in part on user behavior data, the first parsing results and the second parsing results are disambiguated to select the first parsing results.
relation<|#|>User Behavior Data<|#|>Second Parsing Results<|#|>disambiguates<|#|>Based at least in part on user behavior data, the first parsing results and the second parsing results are disambiguated to select the first parsing results.
relation<|#|>Query Parser Derivation Computing Device<|#|>Class-Based Language Model Features<|#|>defines<|#|>The query parser derivation computing device defines class-based language model features.
relation<|#|>Query Parser Derivation Computing Device<|#|>Class-Based Language Model Features<|#|>utilizes<|#|>The query parser derivation computing device utilizes the class-based language model features as high-level language model features in deriving the query parser.
